Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You cite market increases, yet your earlier letter says your alloy requirements are covered at fixed prices—it seems the key issue is which increases have actually reached your costs. We value the partnership and want a longer commitment grounded in a transparent price basis. How would you substantiate the requested increase through the cost-breakdown XLSX you offered to discuss, separating fixed-price material costs from processing costs and accounting for increases already reflected in our purchase prices?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Our orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled rose from EUR 5.17 to EUR 5.45 within 9 months (po:4500013278-10, po:4500013392-10, po:4500013795-10, po:4500014455-10). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.72 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We welcome your commitment to a 24-month term for 94,800 units per year, which enables us to lower our offer to €5.31 per unit.
To support this extended 24-month period, we must include the AS-14404 index clause, as our alloy requirements are only covered at fixed prices for a limited time.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.31 per unit.
We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You tie the need for an alloy clause to the limited duration of your fixed-price coverage—it sounds like your concern is exposure after that protection expires. We want a defensible price basis that distinguishes secured costs from future risk. How can we separate that future exposure from the base price while your alloy costs remain fixed?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.82 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We are pleased to present our final Angebot for your requirements. This is our letztes Angebot, so please decide on how you would like to proceed.

Our offer stands at a price of €5.03 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We do not share our internal cost-breakdown workbooks, but please be assured that our base price reflects current costs without any built-in allowance for future exposure. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Regarding your query ("Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data."), the AS-14404 index clause is precisely what prevents double counting, as it transparently handles future fluctuations after our fixed-price coverage ends in March 2027.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.15 per unit, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
